description_en: Loads session history, receives subsequent output, or resumes Server-Sent Events (SSE) from a saved read position
description_zh: 加载会话历史、接收后续输出，或从已保存的读取位置恢复 SSE
name: LoadAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC version. Set this parameter to `2.0`
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The client call identifier used to associate the current response. It does not provide idempotency guarantees
parameters.help_zh: 客户端调用标识，用于关联本次响应，不提供幂等保证
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The business parameter structure. For core nested fields, see the supplementary description
parameters.help_zh: 业务参数结构，核心嵌套字段见补充说明
parameters.name: params

Error.description_en: The `Error` field in the frame. It is an in-stream error and is actually an object
Error.description_zh: 帧中的 `Error`；流内错误，实际为对象

Id.description_en: The `Id` field in the frame, used to associate the request. Notification frames may not contain this field
Id.description_zh: 帧中的 `Id`，用于关联请求。通知帧可能不包含

Jsonrpc.description_en: The `Jsonrpc` field in the frame. The value is `2.0`

Method.description_en: The `Method` field in the frame, used to distinguish notification categories
Method.description_zh: 帧中的 `Method`，用于区分通知类别

Params.description_en: The `Params` field in the frame. It is the notification payload and is actually an object
Params.description_zh: 帧中的 `Params`；通知载荷，实际为对象

RequestId.description_en: The request diagnostic identifier. It is not guaranteed to be included in every frame. You should also retain the diagnostic information in the response headers
RequestId.description_zh: 请求诊断标识；不保证每帧携带，应同时保留响应头中的诊断信息

Result.description_en: The `Result` field in the frame. It is the normal result and is actually an object
Result.description_zh: 帧中的 `Result`；正常结果，实际为对象
